title: fix(plugin-list,plugin-grid): ask for a referenceVia pointer's type half in $select (objectui#13036)
body:
Fixes #13036
Clause-②: no

## What

A `referenceVia` pointer column (objectui#12608) resolves its record from the row: `resolveRecordPointer` reads the sibling the field names and answers null when it is absent, so the column then draws the stored id. Neither projection builder asked for that sibling, so a list showing `record_id` without `object_name` drew the raw record id.

Both builders now harvest the `referenceVia` sibling of every **projected** pointer column:

- `ListView` `selectFields`: for each column that survived the FLS gate (`cols`), the declared field's `referenceVia` goes through `addSpeculative`, the same declared-field + FLS-readable gate the grouping, row-colour and deadline harvests take.
- `ObjectGrid` `getSelectFields`: a new `referenceViaFields` harvest, read from the shown columns that pass `passesProjectionGate`, then `isProjectableField` and `passesProjectionGate`, unioned into `extraFields`. This is the projection a grid-owned grouped fetch (`gridOwnsGroupedFetch`) and a standalone `object-grid` send.

A sibling the viewer may not read is not asked for, and that row keeps the stored text (the half-addressed control). A sibling the object does not declare is not sent. `resolveRecordPointer` and the cell are unchanged; no new export.

## Pins

- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.referenceViaSelect-13036.test.tsx`: (a) a list whose `columns` omit the type half asks for it on `ListView`'s fetch, and the rows handed to the grid resolve to the record through `resolveRecordPointer` (plugin-list does not depend on plugin-grid, so a stub grid stands in); control: a genuinely blank sibling stays half-addressed; an FLS-unreadable sibling is not selected; an FLS-unreadable pointer column harvests nothing; an undeclared sibling is not sent; a sibling that is a column is sent once.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.referenceViaSelect-13036.test.tsx`: the real grid draws the record (link named `Acme renewal`) on its own fetch and (b) on every group row page of a server-grouped grid; (c) control: a genuinely blank sibling keeps the stored text; an FLS-unreadable sibling is not selected and the row keeps the stored text; plus the same undeclared / denied-pointer / sent-once rows.

## Ablation (once per behaviour, through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob hash)

- `ListView.tsx`: deleting the harvest line turned 2 of 6 red (the (a) pin and the blank-sibling control's `toContain('object_name')`). Restored: blob after restore == HEAD (`81f118cf6701`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx`: dropping `...referenceViaFields` from `extraFields` turned 3 of 7 red (own fetch, server-grouped fetch (b), blank-sibling control). Restored: blob == HEAD (`4c2fbdbb6281`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

The tests import the components from source (`../ListView`, `../ObjectGrid`), so no rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.

## Verification (at `6d2f81b3f3`)

- New tests: plugin-list 6/6, plugin-grid 7/7.
- Projection-family tests: plugin-grid 13 files / 139 tests pass; plugin-list 13 files / 109 tests pass.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` exit 0, after the dependency closure build; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists each new test.
- `eslint` on the 4 changed files, per package as their `lint` scripts run it: 0 errors; no warning falls on the changed source lines.
- Exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:new-line-citations`.
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/plugin-list/` and `packages/plugin-grid/` directory runs. A local `packages/plugin-grid/` run hit the 590s foreground limit before it reported, so it is NOT MEASURED here.
